pages.text: You can get status of aquarium using Redstone Comparator. It will return value based on available actions under binary value [0000].

pages.title: [000x]
pages.text: First bit returns if aquarium is empty. It will emit signal 0 only if aquarium is empty.

pages.title: [00x0]
pages.text: Second bit returns if animal can be breed. $(br2)When outcome is 3, 7, 11 or 15, breeding is available. $(br2)When outcome is 0, 1, 5, 9, or 13, breeding is on cooldown.

pages.title: [0x00]
pages.text: Third bit returns if player can use first interaction. $(br2)When outcome is 5, 7, 13, or 15, first interaction is available. $(br2)When outcome is 0, 1, 3, 9, or 11, interaction is on cooldown.

pages.title: [x000]
pages.text: Forth bit returns if player can use second interaction. $(br2)When outcome is 9, 11, 13, or 15, second interaction is available. $(br2)When outcome is 0, 1, 3, 5, or 7, interaction is on cooldown.
